title: Crouzeix--Raviart--Marini realisation of computable a priori $L^2$-error bounds on anisotropic meshes
summary: We consider conforming $\Pone$ and lowest-order Crouzeix--Raviart (CR) approximations of the Dirichlet Poisson problem in two and three dimensions. We obtain computable a priori $L^2$-error bounds on anisotropic simplicial meshes without a global $H^2$-regularity assumption. For piecewise constant data, the Marini relation gives an equilibrated lowest-order Raviart--Thomas (RT) flux from the scalar CR solution.
